texts.arguments: 3. Learned Senior Counsel would submit that the 1st petitioner is proprietor of Supreme Inc and 2nd petitioner is Manager of M/s Bhole Baba Organic Dairy Milk Private Limited and they were arrayed as Accused Nos.12 and 15 in Crime No.470 of 2024 of East Police Station, Tirupati, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 274, 275, 316(5), 318(3), 318(4), 61(2), 299, 336(3), 340(2) r/w 49 and 3(5) of BNS and Section 51 & 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act. Learned Senior Counsel would further submit that they were enlarged on bail and now the petitioners were issued notices to appear before the Investigating Officer without any reasonable grounds. Learned Senior Counsel would further submit that the petitioners may be permitted to have the presence of their counsel at the time of examination by SIT. 4. Learned Special Public Prosecutor for CBI would submit that the presence of the petitioners is necessary for further examination and hence, they were issued notices to appear before the SIT. Learned Special Public Prosecutor would further submit that presence of Advocate is not at all necessary in this matter since the petitioners were arrested and released on bail.
